issues.title: Epic: 3-day operational prototype - northern KP flash-flood early warning
issues.body:
## Goal

A working, honest prototype in 3 days: real Open-Meteo data for 8 northern-KP basins, two models (cloudburst + snowmelt), fusion, an app, and one live run.

Domain: **Swat, Dir (Panjkora), Chitral** - not Peshawar/Gomal/Kohat.

## Non-negotiables

- [ ] Both mechanisms run on **every** basin. No basin is "melt only" or "cloudburst only".
- [ ] All timestamps UTC.
- [ ] Label thresholds and tier cutoffs fitted on TRAIN years only.
- [ ] Test split (2024-2025) evaluated **once**, on Day 3, with both people present.
- [ ] Shadow mode only. Nothing goes to the public.

## Basin set

| basin_id | Control point | Lat | Lon | Snow frac |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `swat_kalam` | Swat R at Kalam | 35.48 | 72.58 | 0.45 |
| `swat_madyan` | Swat R at Madyan | 35.05 | 72.55 | 0.35 |
| `swat_chakdara` | Swat R at Chakdara | 34.65 | 72.03 | 0.30 |
| `panjkora_dir` | Panjkora R at Dir | 35.20 | 71.88 | 0.38 |
| `panjkora_talash` | Panjkora R at Talash | 34.93 | 71.98 | 0.30 |
| `chitral_mastuj` | Yarkhun at Mastuj | 36.28 | 72.28 | 0.60 |
| `chitral_drosh` | Chitral R at Drosh | 35.56 | 71.79 | 0.52 |
| `chitral_chitral` | Chitral R at Chitral | 35.85 | 71.79 | 0.52 |
| `indus_besham` | Indus R at Besham (optional) | 34.92 | 72.87 | 0.35 |

## Schedule

| Day | Person 1 | Person 2 |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Ingest + QA, labels A, features A, baseline A | Static table, labels B, features B, baseline B |
| D2 | CNN-LSTM A (3 seeds) | LSTM B (3 seeds), eval harness, fusion v2 |
| D3 | Replay + live run | App, single test evaluation, demo |

## Gates

- **D1 16:30** - real data on Drive for all 8 basins; both baselines scored.
- **D2 17:00** - both deep models trained; fused validation predictions exist; test untouched.
- **D3 17:00** - demo runs end to end; test numbers recorded once.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Real data for 8 basins on Drive
- [ ] Model A, Model B and both baselines scored on validation
- [ ] Fused predictions with drivers and compound flag
- [ ] App: map, dual mechanism bars, replay slider, alert log
- [ ] One live run against Open-Meteo
- [ ] Single test evaluation recorded in `docs/log.md`
- [ ] Repo a teammate can clone and run

## Sub-issues

See the linked issues below. Nothing is assigned by day until the D1 gate passes.

issues.title: [P1 / D1] Ingest real Open-Meteo data for 8 basins
issues.body:
**Owner:** Person 1 · **Budget:** 2h · **Blocks:** everything

## What

Pull real reanalysis + discharge for all 8 basins and write parquet to the shared Drive folder.

Sources (no API key, no account):

- `archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive` - hourly `precipitation`, `temperature_2m`, `soil_moisture_0_to_7cm`, `snow_depth`
- `flood-api.open-meteo.com/v1/flood` - daily `river_discharge` (GloFAS)

## How

Sample a **3x3 grid** around each control point (+/- 0.1 deg), not a single point. Compute per basin:

- `rain_mean`, `rain_max`, `rain_wet_fraction`
- `temp_mean`, `soil_mean`, `snow_depth_mean`

`rain_max` is what catches a cloudburst that a basin mean would erase.

## Output

```
data/raw/archive_<basin_id>.parquet
data/raw/discharge_<basin_id>.parquet
data/processed/basin_hourly.parquet
data/processed/qa_report.json
```

## Done when

- [ ] 8 basins present, 2015-01-01 to 2025-12-31
- [ ] all timestamps UTC, 3h resampled
- [ ] no basin missing more than 2% of expected rows
- [ ] units checked (mm, degC, m3/m3, m, m3/s)
- [ ] Aug 2022 sanity check: Swat and Chitral both show a rain peak
- [ ] `qa_report.json` lists row counts, gaps and min/max per variable

## Pitfalls

- Chunk requests into 2-year blocks; a single 11-year request can time out.
- Do not silently forward-fill discharge. Mark gaps and let the label step handle them.
- A basin with no discharge must still flow through Model A.

issues.title: [P1 / D1] Cloudburst proxy labels, features A, baseline A
issues.body:
**Owner:** Person 1 · **Budget:** 3h · **Depends on:** #ingest

## What

Build the cloudburst label and feature set, then train the gradient-boosted baseline.

## Rules

- Label A: 3h rain >= p95 of **train years** (with a physical floor of 20 mm), OR >= 70% of threshold on already-wet soil.
- **Positive-count fallback:** if a basin has fewer than 30 positive training rows, it inherits the pooled threshold. Without this, Chitral's cloudburst label is all-negative and Model A can never learn it there.
- Horizon: 2 steps = 6h ahead.

## Features

Short-window rain (3/6/12/24/72h), rain anomaly vs 30-day mean, soil moisture + trend, `rain x soil`, seasonality, and **forecast features** (`rain_next_3h`, `rain_next_12h`, `forecast_excess`). Without forecast features the model can only nowcast and lead time collapses to zero.

## Output

```
data/processed/labels_a.parquet
models/baseline_a.joblib
models/baseline_a_validation.json
```

## Done when

- [ ] label base rate between 0.3% and 3% on train
- [ ] baseline A scored on validation: POD, FAR, CSI, PR-AUC, event POD, lead time
- [ ] lead time > 0h (proves forecast features are wired)
- [ ] no validation or test row used to fit a threshold

issues.title: [P2 / D1] Snowmelt labels, features B, baseline B
issues.body:
**Owner:** Person 2 · **Budget:** 3h · **Depends on:** #ingest

## What

Build the melt/high-flow label and feature set, then train the baseline.

## Rules

- Label B: GloFAS discharge >= p90 of **train years**, per basin.
- Horizon: 8 steps = 24h ahead.
- **Applies to all basins.** Swat and Dir have headwater snow too; do not filter them out.
- If discharge is missing for a basin, B falls back to the rule engine and is flagged low-confidence. It must never render as probability 0.

## Features

Degree-day melt index, `melt_3d`, `melt_7d`, `melt_next_24h`, `temp_next_max`, `temp_7d_mean`, `rain_7d`, recent discharge lags and ratio, seasonality.

## Output

```
data/processed/labels_b.parquet
models/baseline_b.joblib
models/baseline_b_validation.json
```

## Done when

- [ ] label base rate ~10% on train (p90 by construction)
- [ ] baseline B scored on validation with the same metric set as A
- [ ] Chitral basins show the expected June-August melt peak
- [ ] no leakage across the split boundary

issues.title: [P1 / D2] Train CNN-LSTM Model A (3 seeds)
issues.body:
**Owner:** Person 1 · **Budget:** 5h · **Depends on:** #labels-a

## What

CNN-LSTM over a 72h x 3h window. Conv1D(32) -> Conv1D(64) -> LSTM(64) -> dense. BCE with positive weighting. Basin embedding so the model learns which basins respond to rain instead of being told.

## Steps

- [ ] 09:30-12:30 - one seed, debug shapes and overfitting on a small slice
- [ ] 13:00-15:00 - seeds 0, 1, 2; checkpoint every epoch to Drive
- [ ] 15:00-16:00 - validation tuning (dropout, lr, class weight)

## Output

```
models/model_a_seed0.pt  (and seed1, seed2)
models/model_a_val_predictions.parquet
models/model_a_validation.json
```

## Done when

- [ ] three seeds trained, checkpoint files on Drive
- [ ] ensemble (mean of 3) beats or matches baseline A on validation CSI
- [ ] per-basin validation CSI reported for all 8 basins
- [ ] if it loses to the baseline, say so - the baseline becomes the headline model

## Pitfalls

- `/content` is disposable. Save to Drive every epoch.
- Keep the runtime under 4h per Colab session.
- Never touch the test split here.

issues.title: [P2 / D2] Train LSTM Model B (3 seeds) + evaluation harness
issues.body:
**Owner:** Person 2 · **Budget:** 5h · **Depends on:** #labels-b

## What

Two things in parallel: the melt LSTM, and the evaluation harness that both people will use.

## Model B

- 30-day daily window, LSTM(64) x 2 -> dense
- BCE with positive weighting
- Basin embedding; trained pooled across all 8 basins

## Evaluation harness

One function that takes a predictions parquet and a split name and returns:

- point POD / FAR / CSI / precision / F1
- base rate and alert rate (so FAR is interpretable)
- PR-AUC and Brier
- event-level POD / FAR / CSI
- median lead time in hours
- bootstrap confidence intervals, **blocked by event**

## Output

```
models/model_b_seed0.pt  (and seed1, seed2)
models/model_b_val_predictions.parquet
src/floodwatch/evaluate.py   (harness complete)
```

## Done when

- [ ] three seeds trained and checkpointed
- [ ] harness runs on a dummy prediction frame and produces all metrics
- [ ] lead-time measurement uses the **raw** label, not the forward-shifted one
- [ ] harness refuses `--split test` without `--confirm-test`

issues.title: [P2 / D2] Fusion v2 + validation calibration
issues.body:
**Owner:** Person 2 · **Budget:** 1.5h · **Depends on:** #model-a, #model-b

## Rule

```
p_A, p_B   calibrated, every basin, every step
base       = max(p_A, p_B)
compound   if tier(p_A) >= moderate AND tier(p_B) >= moderate -> escalate 1
rain-on-snow  if guard fires AND base >= moderate -> escalate 1
```

**Rain-on-snow guard:** `snow_depth > threshold` AND `rain_24h > threshold` AND `temp > 0` -> at least `moderate`, flag `rain_on_snow`. It is a rule, labelled as a rule.

## Also

- Calibrate probabilities (isotonic, internal CV on train only).
- Propose tier cutoffs from **validation**, write to `models/thresholds_proposal.yaml`.
- Produce the **per-basin A/B weight table** from validation. That table is the proof that both mechanisms run everywhere.

## Output

```
models/thresholds_proposal.yaml
models/mechanism_weights.csv
src/floodwatch/fusion.py   (v2)
```

## Done when

- [ ] fused frame validates against the prediction schema
- [ ] compound escalation tested
- [ ] rain-on-snow guard tested
- [ ] mechanism weights show nonzero A and B in every basin

issues.title: [P1 / D3] Replay Aug 2022 + live operational run
issues.body:
**Owner:** Person 1 · **Budget:** 3h · **Depends on:** #fusion

## What

- Replay the August 2022 window with real data.
- One live pass against the Open-Meteo forecast endpoint.
- Harden the failure path: one basin failing must not kill the run.

## Also fix

`runner._to_predictions` reads `rain_mm_3h` from the model output frame, which only has `basin_id, timestamp_utc, prob`. Merge probabilities back onto the feature table before building driver strings. This currently crashes `06_run_demo.py`.

## Output

```
runs/<run_id>/predictions_a.parquet
runs/<run_id>/predictions_b.parquet
runs/<run_id>/predictions_fused.parquet
runs/<run_id>/alerts.json
runs/<run_id>/run_report.json
```

## Done when

- [ ] replay run completes and writes a full run directory
- [ ] live run completes, health status `ok`
- [ ] demo run demonstrates **Chitral** (rain-driven) and **Swat** (rain + melt) both firing
- [ ] a single failed basin degrades gracefully and is listed in `run_report.json`

issues.title: [P2 / D3] Streamlit app + single test evaluation + demo
issues.body:
**Owner:** Person 2 · **Budget:** 5h · **Depends on:** #ops, #fusion

## App must show

- [ ] Map with a coloured tier per basin
- [ ] **Two probability bars per basin** (cloudburst A, melt B) plus the fused tier - not one mechanism label
- [ ] Compound badge and rain-on-snow badge
- [ ] Replay slider over the run
- [ ] Alert log (shadow mode) with drivers
- [ ] **GLOF disclaimer** - explicitly not predicted
- [ ] Demo/synthetic banner when `mode=demo`

## Single test evaluation (13:00-14:00, both present)

- [ ] run once against 2024-2025
- [ ] record run id and numbers in `docs/log.md`
- [ ] do not re-run to improve the numbers

## Done when

- [ ] app loads the latest run with no manual edits
- [ ] both mechanisms visible for Chitral **and** Swat
- [ ] test numbers recorded once
- [ ] 5-minute demo rehearsed twice
